title: Concentrated vs. Distributed Failures x Monitor Thresholds: Compounding Through Misconfigured Alerting

original_idea.body: Simulate rare-high-severity vs many-low-severity attack profiles against a monitored agent, sweep monitor thresholds, and show the threshold trade-off between failure regimes.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Operationalizes an explicit UK AISI open problem with a measurable threshold trade-off curve.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Threshold sweep over two attack profiles; largely simulation, accessible with mentor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single trade-off curve over a threshold sweep with clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Lab-independent, public models, addresses an AISI priority.

novelty.reasoning: Concentrated/distributed distinction named; the explicit threshold trade-off curve may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: AISI distinction named; explicit threshold trade-off measurement may be open.
